usage: agentbreeder services logs [-h] [--tail N] [--since D] [--follow]
                                  [--json] [--raw]
                                  [DIR] NAME [[DIR] NAME ...]

positional arguments:
  [DIR] NAME

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --tail N    The last N lines (default 200, at most 10000)
  --since D   Only lines since D (10m, 2h, 2026-11-11T09:00:00Z)
  --follow    Keep printing new lines until the service stops, Ctrl-C,
              SIGTERM, SIGHUP or the end of a non-terminal stdin
  --json      Print the result as JSON
  --raw       Print control characters as they are (unsafe; --json always
              escapes)
